reader.requirement: At --std 85 a file-name in a SAME AREA or SAME RECORD AREA clause, in either the file-name-1 or a file-name-2 position, must not name a file whose FD carries IS EXTERNAL; such an operand must be refused, and non-external files in the same program are admitted.
reader.edition-search: Same search as SR1: ScreenSameOperands tests file.IsExternal with no edition switch; the only edition test in the file is SameOccurrenceRule's report-file row.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers one external operand; not exercised: external in the file-name-1 position and in SAME RECORD AREA

probes.printed: COBOL2738 SAME AREA: file 'FE' references an external file connector (file-name-1 position); COBOL2738 SAME RECORD AREA: file 'FF' references an external file connector (file-name-2 position)

probes.expected: an EXTERNAL file outside every SAME clause is unaffected; the non-external SAME clauses are accepted and share the record area

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.2.13.3 SR2  (2.13.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2 [may not reference an external file connector]

reader.notes: The external test runs on every resolved operand of every SAME format, so both positions and both the AREA and RECORD AREA forms are refused at --std 85 with COBOL2738.

refuter.evidence: q6ref.cob (--compile-only): FD IS GLOBAL IS EXTERNAL in SAME RECORD AREA file-name-1 position and FD IS EXTERNAL IS GLOBAL in SAME AREA file-name-2 position both draw COBOL2738 'references an external file connector', so the clause order inside the FD and the GLOBAL combination do not hide the external flag.
